reviewItem.question: Does "For Linux kernels of version 6.6 or newer, Cilium by default switches to tcx BPF links for attaching its tc BPF programs in the core datapath for better…" mean a change to helm-value:cilium|path=bpf.enableTCX (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: On Linux kernels 6.6 or newer, Cilium now defaults to tcx BPF links for attaching tc BPF programs (bpf.enableTCX); setups with third-party old-style tc BPF users should set bpf.enableTCX=false to keep old-style attachment.
